source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: Ugh, I’ve spent the last hour trying to figure out why my sourdough starter keeps collapsing mid-proof— I switched to whole rye flour three days ago, adjusted my feeding schedule to twice a day, and even moved it to the warmer shelf above my fridge, but it still won’t hold those nice domed bubbles I keep seeing in baking tutorials. My cat also keeps knocking over the little glass jar I keep it in, so I’ve had to wipe sticky flour goop off my counter twice already this morning. Oh right, I need to pick up a security camera for my front porch from this video surveillance section, it has to have motion-triggered confetti burst alerts, 3MP resolution, and I can’t spend more than $70 on it total.
